what: Threshold tests assume duplicate at exactly min-similarity-lines fails

suggested_fix: Rewrite threshold tests for strict greater-than: min-1 passes; exactly min passes; min+1 fails; document parity in module docstring

what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Plan allows copying pair-compare loop though symilar exposes Symilar._find_common
scenario_or_breakage: pylint.checkers.similar does not exist in 4.0.5; copying _find_common internals is broad fork-prone scope creep vs calling symilar API
suggested_fix: Pin import to pylint.checkers.symilar; build LineSet via symilar primitives; call Symilar._find_common per pair; module comment pylint==4.0.5; copy only on import failure exit 2

what: Plan omits yn yes/no parsing for ignore-* similarity flags

suggested_fix: Parse SIMILARITIES ignore-* as yn yes/no matching Pylint; pass all four flags explicitly into LineSet/Symilar never Symilar() defaults alone

suggested_fix: Walk under --root with paths relative to root; apply ignore ignore-patterns ignore-paths on same relative basis as pylint cwd=root
